name: VAT 2 — Return for Value Added Tax
legal_reference: Value-Added Tax Act, 2000, s. 23(2) — the tax period of a registered person is two calendar months: Category A, ending in January, March, May, July, September and November; Category B, ending in February, April, June, August, October and December, the Commissioner choosing the category (s. 23(3)); a farmer may elect two, four, six or twelve months, and a person registered under s. 15(4) six months. s. 24(1) — a return is furnished for every period whether or not tax is payable. `bimonth` is anchored on January–February, which is Category B; a Category A taxpayer (December–January, February–March…) is not expressible by this format and is recorded in the README. The category is NamRA's decision about the taxpayer, so no period_default is declared and `ekwo init` asks.

deadline.legal_reference: Value-Added Tax Act, 2000, s. 24(1) — not later than the twenty-fifth day of the month following the end of the tax period; the NamRA brochures say the same. The Commissioner may extend the time to furnish a return but not the time to pay (s. 24(4) and (5)).

boxes.name: Row 8 — Trading: sales/fees — value excluding VAT, 15 % column
boxes.legal_reference: VAT 2 return (Ministry of Finance, Inland Revenue), VAT declared (Outputs), row 8, 15 % column: the value excluding VAT and the output tax (the form asks whole Namibia dollars and ignores cents).

boxes.name: Row 8 — Trading: sales/fees — output tax
boxes.legal_reference: VAT 2 return (Ministry of Finance, Inland Revenue), VAT declared (Outputs), row 8, 15 % column: the value excluding VAT and the output tax (the form asks whole Namibia dollars and ignores cents).

boxes.name: Row 8Z — Trading: sales/fees — zero-rated
boxes.legal_reference: VAT 2 return (Ministry of Finance, Inland Revenue), VAT declared (Outputs), row 8, zero-rated column: exports and the local zero-rated supplies of Schedule III.

boxes.name: Row 8E — Trading: sales/fees — exempt
boxes.legal_reference: VAT 2 return (Ministry of Finance, Inland Revenue), VAT declared (Outputs), row 8, exempt column.

boxes.name: Row 10E — Output adjustments — exempt

boxes.legal_reference: VAT 2 return (Ministry of Finance, Inland Revenue), row 12: the total output tax due, carried to block 5. The totals of row 11 are column sums of the rows above and are not repeated.

boxes.name: Row 17 — Input adjustments — input tax
boxes.legal_reference: VAT 2 return (Ministry of Finance, Inland Revenue), VAT claimed (Inputs), row 17, 15 % column: credit notes received reduce the input tax; the pack holds them negative.

boxes.name: Block 7 — Amount due / repayable (block 5 less block 6)
boxes.legal_reference: VAT 2 return (Ministry of Finance, Inland Revenue), blocks 5 to 7: total output tax due, less input tax claimed, gives the amount due or repayable. A negative figure is a refund under s. 38 of the Value-Added Tax Act, 2000.
